name: Outside Service Queue
summary: Waitlist-first Outside Service workflow for MySQL-backed requests with gated Setup access, direct waitlist completion prompts for setup-phase lines, editable setup details, forced custom-vendor fallback when no suggestions exist, shared-shell section headers that avoid duplicate in-page notifications, and JSON-backed mock vendor and part suggestions when Infor Visual mock mode is enabled.

userActions: Create a new outside service request
Open Setup only after selecting a waitlist line
Edit setup-phase lines without completing them
Save setup details and package changes
Mark setup lines complete from the waitlist after a yes or no prompt
preserveRules: Keep View to ViewModel to Service to DAO to Database flow intact
Keep whole-collection waitlist, history, vendor-suggestion, and package-editor refreshes behaviorally equivalent
Keep MySQL writes inside stored procedures only
acceptanceCriteria: The shell opens from the main navigation
The shared window header reflects the active Outside Service section
The waitlist tab is the first Outside Service section shown
Request entry can stage and save one or more lines
Open lines appear in the waitlist after save
Setup cannot be opened until a waitlist line is selected
Setup data can be saved and setup-phase lines can be edited without being completed
Setup-phase lines can be marked complete directly from the waitlist after confirmation
validationHints: Confirm an invalid part ID opens Part Match Helper when the Part ID field loses focus
Confirm package count and package rows must match
Confirm the Add Line modal opens with the wider custom header layout
Confirm Setup stays disabled when no waitlist line is selected
Confirm vendor suggestions are ordered by most recent dispatch
Confirm the Scheduled ship field uses the same calendar popup experience as Module_Reporting instead of the wheel-style DatePicker
Confirm the Setup scheduled ship calendar can be cleared and reselected without crashing the screen
Confirm Infor Visual suggestion and validation paths fall back only when mock data mode is enabled
Confirm mock fallback part and vendor suggestions now use the generated JSON-backed Infor Visual catalog
Confirm waitlist and history filters do not hide valid rows unexpectedly
Confirm waitlist rows, history rows, vendor suggestions, and setup package editors still repopulate correctly after whole-collection replacement
Confirm Complete History defaults to a blank Search box with Vendor and Completed both set to All whenever the user navigates into the History tab
Confirm Complete History defaults to All so older completed rows remain visible
Confirm setup-phase waitlist rows show separate Edit and Mark Complete actions
Confirm Mark Complete prompts for Yes or No and does not navigate into Setup
Confirm setup editing allows package count, per-package quantities, vendor, reference number, scheduled ship date, shipping contact, and setup notes to be changed
Confirm the suggested-vendor dropdown hides and custom vendor is forced on when no suggested vendors are returned
Confirm the shared header toast remains while duplicate in-page Outside Service InfoBars are removed
